_README: Web-sourced (named-outlet) facts used in the 2026-10-16 brief (covering Thursday 2026-10-15's close), recorded per CLAUDE.md §14 so every attribution in prose traces to a file. Method: four topic researchers (press/macro, movers, Tier 3 AI financing, calendar/Fed/overnight), each capped at a fixed share of the session's 200-search budget, then an independent fact-checker per topic with its own cap re-searched each item. Each item carries what the checker saw, what stayed unconfirmed, the check, and the safe wording the brief follows; Three items are marked '(not checked)': post-Warsh FedWatch odds (not cited), the WTI inventory-draw reason (cited to Nation Thailand only, flagged as single-source), and the WTI/Brent divergence (not cited). Article pages could not be opened in this sandbox (WebFetch DNS failures), so evidence is search-result titles, URLs and snippets showing outlet, date and wording. Where press numbers conflict with the state file, the state file wins (§4C): closes and percentage moves come from data/macro_series.csv, data/raw/movers_2026-10-15.json and data/raw/claims_check_2026-10-16.json.
